notes: Maintenance release: CR audit RF-1b part 2 (#993). Rules behavior changes: Apocalypse trashes the Corp's installed cards as one set through the shared trashCorpCardSet helper (also Singularity): Hostile Infrastructure gets one pending instance per card trashed, its own copy included, Warroid Tracker one per server that lost a card, and the Corp orders them with Calvin B4L3Y in one reaction window (CR 9.12.2a, 9.6.4b, 9.1.8g, 9.2.8d). After a damage interrupt, the paused reaction window finishes before the ability's next instruction, so Apocalypse turns the Runner's cards facedown only after every Hostile Infrastructure instance (CR 9.11.3, 10.3.2). Atman's install ability is a pending conditional with a choice of 0 to N credits, program-use recurring credits included; Mammon gains the 0 option and those credits (CR 9.6.9c, 1.10.3c). Tennin Institute and The Foundry may decline their 'you may' (CR 9.6.9c). Pins cards v1.147.25.
